Package ep.model

Class Assignment

java.lang.Object
ep.model.Assignment
public class Assignment extends Object
An assignment with a deadline. The student gives an estimate of the hours needed and a preferred block length, and the planner turns that into StudyBlocks before the due date. Progress (completed hours and the complete flag) is stored on the assignment as well.

    • Assignment

      public Assignment(String id, String title, LocalDate dueDate, int estimatedHours, int blockLength, String courseId)
      Creates an assignment with no progress recorded.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier
      title - non-blank title
      dueDate - deadline (blocks are placed on days before it)
      estimatedHours - total hours the student expects to need
      blockLength - preferred length of one study block, in hours
      courseId - linked course id or null
